story_options.title: Scientists discover mysterious seahorse lookalikes that no one has ever seen alive
story_options.reason: The nickname “sea muppets,” their bizarre seahorse-like appearance, and the mystery of never seeing one alive create a wonderfully curious animal story. This is the day’s one research-heavy selection.
story_options.title_en: Mysterious “Sea Muppets” Have Never Been Seen Alive
story_options.reason_en: These mysterious seahorse lookalikes combine a wonderfully unusual appearance with the curiosity of a creature no one has ever seen alive.
story_options.en_copy: Scientists have discovered mysterious seahorse lookalikes nicknamed “sea muppets.” Their bizarre appearance is captivating enough on its own, but the biggest mystery remains: no one has ever seen one alive.
story_options.duck_en: A mysterious little lookalike with a very big question mark.
story_options.x_en: Meet the mysterious “sea muppets”: bizarre seahorse lookalikes that no one has ever seen alive. Nature still has plenty of surprises.
story_options.title_ja: 謎の「シーマペット」、生きた姿は誰も見たことがない
story_options.reason_ja: この謎めいたタツノオトシゴそっくりの生き物は、奇妙な姿に加え、誰も生きた個体を見たことがないという好奇心を誘う謎を備えています。
story_options.jp_copy: 科学者たちが、通称「シーマペット」と呼ばれる謎めいたタツノオトシゴそっくりの生き物を発見しました。その奇妙な姿だけでも目を引きますが、最大の謎は、今まで誰も生きた姿を見たことがないことです。
story_options.duck_jp: 大きな謎を抱えた、謎めいたそっくりさんです。
story_options.x_jp: 謎の「シーマペット」に注目。奇妙なタツノオトシゴそっくりの姿をしていますが、生きた個体を見た人はまだ誰もいません。自然には驚きがいっぱいです。

story_options.reason: An ancient shipwreck, pyramid-era cargo, and a lost Mediterranean trading route make this an easy-to-follow historical mystery with strong adventure appeal.
story_options.title_en: A Lost Mediterranean Route May Lead to the World’s Oldest Shipwreck
story_options.reason_en: An ancient shipwreck, pyramid-era cargo, and a lost Mediterranean trading route create an easy-to-follow historical mystery with a strong sense of adventure.
story_options.en_copy: Archaeologists may have found the world’s oldest shipwreck. The discovery is linked to pyramid-era cargo and a lost Mediterranean trading route, turning the seafloor into the setting for an extraordinary historical mystery.
story_options.duck_en: This duck is following an ancient trail across the sea.
story_options.x_en: An ancient shipwreck, pyramid-era cargo, and a lost Mediterranean trading route—archaeologists may be closer to an extraordinary maritime mystery.
story_options.title_ja: 世界最古の難破船か、失われた地中海航路の手がかり
story_options.reason_ja: 古代の難破船、ピラミッド時代の積み荷、そして失われた地中海の交易路が、冒険心をかき立てるわかりやすい歴史ミステリーを生み出しています。
story_options.jp_copy: 考古学者たちが、世界最古の難破船を発見した可能性があります。そこにはピラミッド時代の積み荷と、失われた地中海の交易路が関わっており、海底が驚くべき歴史ミステリーの舞台になっています。
story_options.duck_jp: このカモは、海を越えた古代の手がかりを追っています。
story_options.x_jp: 古代の難破船、ピラミッド時代の積み荷、失われた地中海の交易路。考古学者たちが、驚くべき海の歴史ミステリーに近づいているのかもしれません。

story_options.title: Archaeologists discover 1,200-year-old mummified hairless dog in Peru
story_options.reason: The unusual hairless dogs, preserved puppies, and evidence of ancient human care give readers a memorable window into the bond between people and animals. The burial context makes the emotional tone more reflective than cheerful.
story_options.title_en: A 1,200-Year-Old Hairless Dog Reveals an Ancient Human Bond
story_options.reason_en: Unusual hairless dogs, preserved puppies, and evidence of ancient human care offer a memorable window into the bond between people and animals.
story_options.en_copy: Archaeologists have discovered a 1,200-year-old mummified hairless dog in Peru. Preserved puppies and signs of ancient human care make the find a moving glimpse into a long-standing bond between people and animals.
story_options.duck_en: A small reminder that the bond between people and animals has deep roots.
story_options.x_en: A 1,200-year-old mummified hairless dog and preserved puppies offer a moving glimpse into the ancient bond between people and animals.
story_options.title_ja: 1,200年前の毛のない犬が伝える、古代の人と動物の絆
story_options.reason_ja: 珍しい毛のない犬、保存された子犬、そして古代の人々が大切にしていた証拠が、人と動物の絆を印象的に伝えています。
story_options.jp_copy: 考古学者たちが、ペルーで1,200年前のミイラ化した毛のない犬を発見しました。保存された子犬と、古代の人々が大切にしていた証拠は、人と動物の長く続く絆を感じさせる、心に残る発見です。
story_options.duck_jp: 人と動物の絆には、深い歴史があることを思い出させてくれます。
story_options.x_jp: 1,200年前のミイラ化した毛のない犬と保存された子犬が、人と動物の古くから続く絆を感じさせる、心に残る発見です。

story_options.title: Chinese writing developed square forms gradually, shaped by language, tools and tradition, analysis suggests
story_options.reason: A fresh cultural story about why Chinese characters look the way they do. It is more thoughtful and specialist than the other picks, but offers meaningful variety and avoids repeating the day’s nature and animal themes.
story_options.title_en: How Chinese Writing Gradually Took on Square Forms
story_options.reason_en: This thoughtful cultural story explores why Chinese characters look the way they do, offering meaningful variety through the influence of language, tools, and tradition.
story_options.en_copy: An analysis suggests that Chinese writing developed its square forms gradually, shaped by language, tools, and tradition. The familiar appearance of Chinese characters carries a story of cultural change over time.
story_options.duck_en: A neat reminder that the shapes we recognize often have a long story behind them.
story_options.x_en: Why do Chinese characters look square? An analysis suggests their forms developed gradually, shaped by language, tools, and tradition.
story_options.title_ja: 漢字の四角い形はどのように生まれたのか
story_options.reason_ja: 中国の漢字がなぜ現在のような形に見えるのかを、言語、道具、伝統の影響から考える、意義深く新鮮な文化の話題です。
story_options.jp_copy: 分析によると、中国の文字が四角い形になったのは、長い時間をかけて徐々に発展した結果だと考えられます。その形は、言語や道具、伝統によって形づくられてきました。見慣れた漢字の姿には、時を超えた文化の変化の物語があります。
story_options.duck_jp: 見慣れた形にも、長い物語があることを思い出させてくれます。
story_options.x_jp: なぜ漢字は四角く見えるのでしょう？ 分析によると、その形は言語や道具、伝統に影響されながら、徐々に発展したと考えられます。
